settings.question: Does it taste like wine?
settings.answer: No. It's a cocktail: Blood Orange Margarita (30 calories) or Pineapple Martini (35 calories). If a wine glass is part of your ritual, it pours nicely over ice in one.

settings.question: Will I actually feel it?
settings.answer: Most people feel it around the 10–15 minute mark, and everyone feels it a little differently. Start with one can and give it time before having another. It comes with our 100-day money-back guarantee.

settings.question: How many should I drink?
settings.answer: One can is one serving. Start with one, give it 10–15 minutes, and have another if you want to turn it up. Each can lasts about an hour.

settings.question: Can I drive after drinking it?
settings.answer: We don't recommend it. Your blood alcohol will be zero, but you can still be considered under the influence. Once the feeling has passed, you can drive.

settings.question: How does the trial work?
settings.answer: You get 6 cans for $29.94. We remind you on day 25. On day 28 it renews as a 12-pack at $49.80/mo plus $2.99 shipping. See our policy for cancellation and refund terms.
